ideas.name: Dealer Gamma Intraday Price Dynamics
ideas.claim: Positive market-maker inventory gamma is associated with stronger intraday price reversal, while negative inventory gamma is associated with stronger intraday momentum in the S&P 500.
ideas.quote: We also show evidence suggesting that positive (negative) Market Makers’ inventory gamma strengthens intraday price reversal (momentum).
ideas.mechanism: Market makers' delta hedging of options inventory
ideas.claimed_result: Positive inventory gamma strengthens intraday reversal; negative inventory gamma strengthens intraday momentum.
